ns2:course.label: Musicology and Pedagogy
ns2:course.description: Seminar-style practicum in the teaching of undergraduate courses in Western and non-western music for musicology and non-musicology majors. Intensive review and discussion of pedagogical materials. Instruction in syllabus and lecture design, presentational and discussion styles, and use of multimedia and educational technology. Prerequisite: Graduate musicology majors or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Graduate musicology majors or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
